hook: Sports brands love calling every single ad inspiring. Let's see who actually earned that word.
outro: Two ads, zero apologies. Which one hit harder? Drop it below, and hit subscribe!

items.line: Inarritu directs a global chain reaction. Ronaldinho literally turns into a demon on the pitch. This isn't an ad, it's a short film. S-Tier, no contest!
Kaepernick risks his career for one line. Believe in something, even if it means sacrificing everything. Nike did not play it safe. S-Tier, and they knew exactly what they were doing!
